eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Six
subtitle: Lesson 58 · Subqueries, CTEs, and Views

code:
CREATE VIEW vw_ExpensiveProducts AS
SELECT ProductID, Name, ListPrice, Color
FROM Production.Product
WHERE ListPrice > 1000;
caption: A SELECT statement, saved under a name — unlike a CTE, it persists.

eyebrow: Querying it like a real table
caption: WHERE, ORDER BY, JOIN — all work on a view exactly like a table.

code:
ALTER VIEW vw_ExpensiveProducts AS ...;

DROP VIEW vw_ExpensiveProducts;
caption: ALTER redefines it; DROP removes it permanently.

subtitle: When a view actually does store something.
